# Stephania Pérez | Interior design (Costa del Sol)

> Residential interior design studio based in Marbella, Spain. Mediterranean light, natural materials, bespoke kitchens, villas, and full renovations. Primary language: Spanish. English site available.

Canonical site: https://stephaniaperez.com
Default locale (x-default): Spanish at /es/
English locale: /en/

## What this business is

Stephania Pérez is an interior designer and founder of a studio focused on residential projects on the Costa del Sol (Marbella, Málaga, Benalmádena, Torremolinos, Fuengirola, Alhaurín de la Torre, and surrounding areas). Work includes new-build villas, renovations, custom kitchens, furnishings, and indoor-outdoor living aligned with Mediterranean architecture and climate.

## Services

- New construction interior design (layout, lighting, materials, furnishings)
- Renovations (bathrooms, living areas, exteriors)
- Bespoke kitchen design
- Furniture, finishes, and accessories curation
- Design process from consultation through installation
